top_paper.title: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
top_paper.summary: Compile by training converts natural-language specifications into reusable neural functions by distilling teacher-generated examples into small adapters, enabling efficient deployment without remote model dependencies.

papers.title: When Models Edit Too Much: On the Fidelity of Minimal Code Edits
papers.summary: Large language models frequently over-edit code during repair, but preservation instructions and reinforcement learning can improve edit fidelity without sacrificing correctness.

papers.title: MaxKernel: Agentic Kernel Generation for TPUs
papers.summary: MaxKernel is a multi-agent system that automates TPU kernel development through collaborative, autonomous, and graph-based search paradigms, achieving expert-level performance on diverse benchmarks.

papers.title: RISE: Recursive Improvement via Self-Extrapolating Policy Distillation
papers.summary: RISE improves language model post-training by recursively generating dense token-level supervision from the model's own reinforcement learning trajectory via self-extrapolation, avoiding external teachers.

papers.title: When Quantization Breaks Memory: Recurrent-State Write-Back in Low-Precision Temporal Inference
papers.summary: Quantized recurrent inference suffers from state write-back rules that suppress small updates, but error feedback and residual memory restore accuracy without retraining across GRU and LSTM architectures.

papers.title: Don't Drop Dropout: Optimizing Layer Sparsity for Efficient LLM Training and Inference
papers.summary: Layer dropout improves large language model training efficiency and enables faster inference via early exit and speculative decoding without sacrificing accuracy.

papers.title: WorldSculpt: Generating Compositional Worlds from Grounded Videos
papers.summary: Adapting a single-object 3D generative prior to multi-view observations enables scalable compositional mesh reconstruction of densely cluttered scenes with severe occlusion.

papers.title: Group Adaptive Clipping Policy Optimization
papers.summary: GAPO adaptively adjusts importance-sampling clipping thresholds based on rollout advantage to preserve stronger gradient signals from low-success groups in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

papers.title: Iris: Climbing to the Search Frontier
papers.summary: Two large-scale search agents are trained via a multi-stage pipeline combining supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning against live search, achieving state-of-the-art open-source results on complex web benchmarks through rigorous trajectory filtering and inference-time context management.

papers.title: RoboTok: An Internet-Scale Data Engine for Human Demonstration Retrieval and Dexterous Manipulation Learning
papers.summary: RoboTok retrieves relevant human manipulation videos from the web using a latent motion space derived from 3D hand trajectories to improve robot policy training.

papers.title: A Common Measure of Communication for Speech Brain-Computer Interfaces
papers.summary: Open-vocabulary mutual information provides a unified metric to compare speech brain-computer interfaces across different vocabularies and conditions, revealing trade-offs between vocabulary coverage and decoding accuracy.

papers.title: VeriPhy: Agentic Physical Reasoning for World Model Evaluation and Refinement
papers.summary: VeriPhy verifies generated video by compiling prompts into typed physical obligations, executing frozen expert analyses with provenance tracking, and mapping evidence to auditable three-valued verdicts.

papers.title: Locked at the Entrance, Open Inside: Where RLVR Narrows the Solution Space
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards narrows reasoning diversity primarily at the initial solution step rather than during execution, and targeted interventions can restore coverage without sacrificing accuracy.

papers.title: DRACO: Fine-Grained Credit Assignment with Dynamic Rubrics for Long-Horizon Agent Training
papers.summary: DRACO dynamically generates rubrics and redistributes trajectory-level scores into per-step advantages for reinforcement learning without verifiers, improving long-horizon agent performance.

papers.title: Last Translation Benchmark
papers.summary: The Last Translation Benchmark introduces peer-reviewed, multimodal examples that break leading translation models alongside handcrafted verification rules for reliable, actionable evaluation.

papers.title: QCell: Recombining and Aligning Cell Queries for Overlapping Instance Segmentation
papers.summary: QCell is a query-based model that improves instance segmentation of overlapping microscopy cells through latent-space recombination and contrastive query alignment.

papers.title: Select, Compress, Reinvest: A Controlled Study of Visual-Token Allocation in Long-Video MLLMs
papers.summary: Frame selection dominates accuracy in long-video language models, while spatial compression is nearly free if savings are reinvested into more frames, and a unified harness is needed to compare selectors fairly.

papers.title: Using Grounded Theory for Agent Behavior Analysis at Scale
papers.summary: AutoTraceGT automates grounded theory coding on agent trajectories to build task-specific behavioral taxonomies that recover and extend human failure-mode annotations for downstream prediction.

papers.title: Scal3R: Learning Efficient Multi-Relative Pose Query for Scalable Online 3D Reconstruction
papers.summary: Scal3R improves long-video online 3D reconstruction by querying multi-reference relative poses with lightweight tokens and pose-graph optimization, reducing drift without retraining the backbone.

papers.title: Let Confidence Change, Not the Prediction: Prediction-Preserving Repair for Post-hoc Calibration
papers.summary: CORD is a post-fit adapter that repairs calibrated probability vectors to exactly preserve original top-1 predictions while maintaining calibration quality.

papers.title: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
papers.summary: Compile by training converts natural-language specifications into reusable neural functions by distilling teacher-generated examples into small adapters, enabling efficient deployment without remote model dependencies.

papers.title: Percolation Dynamics in Optimization : Variance Cascades and Discrete Scale Invariance
papers.summary: Stochastic gradient descent dynamics are modeled as a percolation process where architectural symmetries cause subnetworks to merge in discrete blocks, producing variance spikes resembling phase transitions, with similar trapping behavior extending to Adam and AdamW under heavy-tailed noise.

papers.title: PACE: Towards Surfacing Hidden Conflicts in User Requests
papers.summary: PaceMaker uses coordinated agents to retrieve implicit contextual evidence and evaluate whether personalized requests conflict with hidden user constraints.

papers.title: Knowing When Not to Reuse: Conditional Experience Transfer in Autonomous LLM Post-Training
papers.summary: Boundary-Calibrated Intervention Transfer selectively reuses past training evidence by checking contextual applicability and running bounded trials, reducing harmful updates and improving final model quality in autonomous post-training.

papers.title: Puffin-World: Scaling a Unified Multimodal Model with Native 3D World States
papers.summary: Puffin-World is a unified multimodal framework that jointly models physics, geometry, and appearance for physically consistent 3D world generation, reconstruction, and closed-loop exploration.

papers.title: Beyond Retrieval: Progressive Latent Memory Evolution for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.summary: LatentStream introduces a progressive latent working memory framework that internalizes streaming visual evidence into compact evolving tokens for continuous reasoning.

papers.title: The Missing Temporal Link: Temporal Context Routing for Script-Driven Audio-Video Generation
papers.summary: Temporal Context Routing improves script-aligned timing of shots and dialogue in joint audio-video generation by mapping structured script timing onto shared video-audio temporal axes.

papers.title: FlashRender: Few-Step Generative Rendering via Camera-Controlled Video MeanFlow
papers.summary: FlashRender accelerates generative video rendering via representation alignment, a mean-flow objective, and on-policy distillation to achieve high-quality few-step camera-controlled synthesis.

papers.title: WorldReward: Reward Modeling for Camera-Conditioned World Models
papers.summary: WorldReward is a vision-language reward model that evaluates camera-conditioned world models by aligning video chunks with actions and aggregating preferences for both execution consistency and visual quality.

papers.title: Random Attention: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction for Efficient Reasoning
papers.summary: Random eviction of reasoning tokens matches selective KV cache compression because reasoning traces are self-protecting through redundancy, making scoring unnecessary once prompts are preserved.

papers.title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models II: One Training Example
papers.summary: On-policy distillation improves over hundreds of steps from a single query by rapidly covering teacher states, yet student alignment remains slow, indicating the method is algorithm-starved rather than data-starved.
